issues: The heading hierarchy is illogical: specific news article titles are used as h2s, then some of the same titles are repeated as h3s under a general 'Новости' (News) h2.
Headings at the h2 level lack parallel structure, mixing specific article titles with general section titles.
Repetitive use of the exact same heading text at different levels (h2 and h3) is confusing and semantically incorrect.
missingSections: Content sections such as 'За министерството' (About the Ministry), 'Регулатива' (Regulation), 'Документи' (Documents), 'Информации' (Information), and 'Услуги' (Services) appear in the body text but are not represented in the heading hierarchy.
suggestions: Restructure the heading hierarchy to ensure a logical flow. All news articles should be nested under a single 'Новости' (News) h2, likely as h3s or h4s.
Ensure headings at the same level represent content of comparable importance. Avoid mixing specific article titles with general section titles at the same level.
Identify and add appropriate headings for all significant content sections, such as 'За министерството', 'Регулатива', 'Документи', 'Информации', and 'Услуги'.
Avoid repeating the exact same heading text at different levels unless it's a clear sub-section of the higher-level heading.
items.summary: The heading structure is severely flawed due to an illogical hierarchy, repetition of content at different heading levels, and a lack of parallel structure, making page navigation and understanding difficult for screen reader users.
